*Euros from your salary* helps projects endorsed by Santander employees and funded by donations from the Euros from your salary fund that all Group employees in Spain can contribute to.


##


How to submit a project


1. Find a sponsor. They must be a Banco Santanader employee who contributes to the *Euros from your salary* fund.
2. Check the entry rules in the corresponding document. Got a question? Email us ateurosdetunomina@gruposantander.com
3. Your sponsor must complete the project submission form, which is only available to employees, via the link in the entry rules or by[clicking here](https://www.santanderx.com/es/sites/euros-de-tu-nomina.html) .
4. You can enter up to three projects into one of five categories:


**Social inclusion**


**Disability**


**Health**


**International cooperation**


**Commitment**


[Submission form](https://www.santanderx.com/es/sites/euros-de-tu-nomina.html)
